been registered with this GP for 1.5 years now and feel that I should give my unbiased view on this surgery. I know that there's a lot of negative reviews, and there are definetely issues, but it's harmful to say outright that you should never join this gp. if you're a student moving to Wales then you need to be prepared that it could take at least a month if not more for your records to get transferred, I'm not sure if this is specifically a problem just with Padarn Surgery or not. As a result, I went a month without pain medication, the surgery was not sympathetic at all with my situation and I feel that I could've been much more supportive. Also, I've been referred to several lists and heard next to nothing from them, the surgery either tries to gaslit me into saying that I have spoken to someone and had it resolved or just forgets about it all together. Several other people I know have had the same issue. So if you have ongoing health conditions I recommend going elsewhere, even if this GP is closer. I have had several blood tests, which have been mostly positive, except from when the surgery switched my blood appointment to a student without my permission, which I'd usually be fine with for anything but blood appointments. The nurses though are lovely, and are probably the only reason that I've actually stayed at the surgery. Some of the receptionists are lovely but I remember last year being snapped at because I was having trouble hearing her, which was incredibly frustrating and unprofessional. Some of the doctors are helpful, but I had requested a test once for a condition I have a family history with, and was told there wasn't a test for it when I know there is (I was scheduled to have one prior to lockdown), which was frustrating. But some doctors have made progress with the diagnosis of my condition and prescribing medication that my previous GP was too lazy and ignorant to care about. The NHS Wales app is useless, I can't see any medical appointments listed or be able to order my prescriptions. And the online referral service is ridiculous! It takes you about 10 minutes to get past all the emergency questions, which sort of defeats the purpose of it being urgent, just for it to be a badly formatted questionare. And the doctors are incredibly bad at communicating through this, I ran out of pain medication again, and was waiting days for a response, but the doctor had issued my medication, just didn't care to tell me, which was so unavoidable. Overall, if you don't have an ongoing condition then I'd say this surgery is fine, but if you do and are capable of travelling a bit further then instead go somewhere in town",null,[0,235]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data\u003d!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xwb2NFRnZhVTFxVDBnNGJXZzJXbEZSTFhwaE1XYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xf6b9faf11e957154!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOlpocEFvaU1qT0g4bWg2WlFRLXphMWc%7C%7C?hl\u003den"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId\u003dCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xwb2NFRnZhVTFxVDBnNGJXZzJXbEZSTFhwaE1XYxAB\u0026t\u003d1\u0026entityid\-rn2KgswZGRPaVhqdGZMRQ\u0026wv\u003d1\u0026d\u003d286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiM-YTa_rKTAxX7MWMBHTeoCsQQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiM-YTa_rKTAxX7MWMBHTeoCsQQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDVTUjBGM1RWOWZSV2hDUW1RMGVqaGpWekZDV1daVlJteHZTVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpRYjBOWk1VVlpSRUYzV1VGRFNVRQ\u003d\u003d"],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2t4elREWk5hMnhCUzBGblpGVmtNM1V6TjJsR1ZtYxAB",["0x0:0xf6b9faf11e957154",null,1772041277591669,1772041277591669,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107985463394950778073/reviews?hl\u003den"],null,null,["Joseph Thomas","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjVO2rS2vlPm1sMHzOsT8aTqysoGu2bqjVbu11Se7OgA-iVVPUeT-w\u003ds120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107985463394950778073?hl\u003den"],"107985463394950778073",null,45,70,null,[1,5,1],3,["Local Guide · 45 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwiM-YTa_rKTAxX7MWMBHTeoCsQQ7LoGCAwoAA"]]]],null,"3 weeks ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Worst surgery, by far in Aberystwyth.
